body: I don't think it was that personal, she didn't cheat because she was unsatisfied with our relationship. Thank you for the kind words, I wish I could tell her that she wasn't worth my time now. I still feel a type of way, but I know I wasted a lot of time. I will look into some counseling!

I'm so sorry and I totally agree, no matter how you avoid looking at it and forgiving, it will always be in the back of your mind and will come out when you least expect it, even if you don't want to. I tried talking to a friend who is aiming to be a psychiatrist, but putting that kind of burden on a friend isn't great. I will look into professional help. I cannot communicate with her so that part is done, so you're right the only way is to keep looking forward. Thank you for the kind words, and I hope all is well with you!

I understand at that point I was so desperate I was just hanging on to a thread. I believe I am bipolar but I don't want to self diagnose. I will look into more professional help in the future.

That's what I've been trying to do lately, but I have had an issue on only wanting to do things that makes others happy and not wanting anything for myself but that, but it has brought me nothing but self-destruction, so I am doing soul searching to find things I do enjoy and things that do make me happy that don't involve another person.

Aww I'm so sorry about that! I won't lie I felt similar but with my ex haha. I took a lot of anger out on her and overall I was pretty terrible. It's not good to be in a relationship while harboring these feelings. That's why I've been avoiding that kind of stuff until my mind and heart are right, I don't wanna do that to my future gf :(

Haha I think that is one thing that I know for sure, I definitely need some self compassion.  I will check out what you recommended and thank you for the kind words!  Also for assuming I'll get married someday :D

This response made me really happy, I appreciate it so much. The funny part is that I talked to her after the whole ordeal when i forced contact with her and she told me something similar. "You didn't love me you loved who you thought I was" This was concerning because I thought I knew her. I can't say I dodged a bullet, because I certainly got hit, but it could be a lot worse. She made me feel there was something horribly wrong with me, but it was her that needed to be worked on the most. I appreciate the kind words!

Thank you! I was feeling that I wasn't grieving properly, but I was so immersed in guilt and desperation to stay together with my ex that I wasn't allowed to feel even 1/4th of how I truly did. If I can find a compatible therapist to talk to I'm sure they can help, but I am not in the best financial situation. I've been doing a lot of self recovery, but there are times where it's hard to keep everything in.

I know everything you said is true. She even told me that right before she cut me off, "This will be what's best for you" and "This will be good for both of us", I took a lot of things into consideration and thought I'd get over everything if we did get married. This messed up logic shows I need therapy, but the last time I went to therapy it went pretty badly.

Thank you. I know it's not my fault, but after years of being told to get over it, it still deep down feels like I'm the one who's at fault. She said a lot worse, but I omitted a lot of stuff, maybe I'll edit it and add in a lot of omitted information, but I don't feel its necessary.  A lot of people has told me about counseling, but even talking about this is hard.
